visual_correlations.comment: The video begins with an introduction of the full bridge rectifier which converts AC power to DC. The full bridge rectifier consists of two AC input pins and two DC output pins. A few things must be considered when choosing a rectifier: the amount of voltage it can handle, the amount of current it can handle, and how much heat will be generated. These specs can be referenced in a given equipment manual or in online resources. Once the full bridge rectifier has been chosen, a corresponding electrolytic capacitor can also be chosen to help smooth out the power from the rectifier. The voltage and capacitance listed on the electrolytic capacitor should be considered in the decision process.

visual_correlations.comment: In this video we learn about the different types of rectifiers and what the best application of each one is.
